schema.name: messages
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE messages (
  id              TEXT    NOT NULL,
  recipient       TEXT    NOT NULL,
  from_id         TEXT    NOT NULL,
  from_name       TEXT    NOT NULL,
  from_agent      TEXT    NOT NULL,
  to_target       TEXT    NOT NULL,
  conversation_id TEXT    NOT NULL,
  reply_to        TEXT,
  hop             INTEGER NOT NULL,
  body            TEXT    NOT NULL,
  created_at      INTEGER NOT NULL,
  read_at         INTEGER,
  PRIMARY KEY (id, recipient)
)

schema.name: idx_messages_unread
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_messages_unread ON messages (recipient, read_at, created_at)

schema.name: idx_messages_id
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_messages_id ON messages (id)

schema.name: archived_messages
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE archived_messages(
  id TEXT,
  recipient TEXT,
  from_id TEXT,
  from_name TEXT,
  from_agent TEXT,
  to_target TEXT,
  conversation_id TEXT,
  reply_to TEXT,
  hop INT,
  body TEXT,
  created_at INT,
  read_at INT,
  archive_reason,
  archived_at
)

schema.name: decisions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE decisions (
  revision INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  topic TEXT NOT NULL,
  body TEXT NOT NULL,
  scope TEXT NOT NULL,
  author_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  author_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  author_agent TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  source_message_id TEXT,
  supersedes TEXT
)

schema.name: sqlite_sequence
schema.sql: CREATE TABLE sqlite_sequence(name,seq)

schema.name: idx_decisions_topic
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_decisions_topic ON decisions (topic, revision)

schema.name: idx_decisions_supersedes
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_decisions_supersedes ON decisions (supersedes)

schema.name: decision_deliveries
